content: <p><strong>Job Summary</strong></p> <p>The Operations Partner is a critical logistical role essential to Bird's success in Calgary. You will take responsibility for the logistics of the local fleet of e-scooters and e-bikes, ensuring they are charged, safe, and positioned correctly to meet the community's transportation needs.</p> <p>We are looking for entrepreneurial individuals or logistics businesses ready to hit the ground running. Whether you are a solo operator with a single van or a fleet owner capable of deploying multiple drivers, you can scale this partnership to fit your capacity.</p> <p>You will have the flexibility to choose how you operate:</p> <ul> <li>Maximize earnings by securing your own space (warehouse/facility) to charge vehicles overnight.</li> <li>Streamline operations by simply retrieving and transporting vehicles to our central warehouse.</li> </ul> <p>This is a pay-per-task opportunity where earnings are directly tied to output. Our products, services, and people share one common goal: to make cities more livable by empowering people and communities everywhere to <strong>move freely, discover new possibilities, and create a cleaner, more connected future.</strong> To cleaner air. Our cleaner, affordable, and on-demand mobility solutions are available in over 200 cities worldwide.</p> <p>We take a collaborative, community-first approach to micromobility.
